Setup.Name: Use Json path
Setup.Description: A simple example on how to parse a json paylog to create detailed metrics manually.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Read Json payload"
    Description: "Read a single metric from a json payload."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/data"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "JSONPATH('$.Processor.Temperature')"
